title: El Cajon Box Mod Case from Wick and Wire
description:
The El Cajon box mod case is the ultimate accessory for the everyday box modder. A customized front flap gives your atty room to breathe. Main pocket includes 2 inside slings with an option to hold your alternate mech mod, extra battery or juice. Reinforced belt loop and extra lanyard to keep in close proximity. Branded logo patch on the front, magnetic snap button on the flap and a laser etched oversized carabiner so you know exactly who its from. Customized for the Modified.

El Cajon Case Dimensions
Height: 5.5 inches
Width: 4.25 inches
Depth: 1.5 inches

Easily fits most popular box mods such as:
100w / 150w Sigelei box mods
iPV3, iPV4 box mods
Kanger sub box
Phantom box mods
Tornado box mods
DPM box mods
